VAN.head: The Golden Knights should be favored
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Canucks are on the second night of a back-to-back. The Canucks can still win it if they get good looks, but a lot has to go their way.

VGK.head: The Golden Knights should be in control
VGK.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Canucks are on the second night of a back-to-back. It’s on the Canucks to make it a game, and they can if they get good looks.
